Rainshower (驟雨の狭間) — Silentroom
Album: In My Heart (2022)
Official track page: https://slrm.bandcamp.com/track/rainshower
Album artwork source: https://f4.bcbits.com/img/a3493216592_5.jpg
The DAW display is an illustrative arrangement study, not the original project or an exact transcription.
The animation is visual only; no song recording is bundled.

Display and content fonts: font resources used by the Zenless Zone Zero official website.
Light body font: Adobe Source Han Sans SC Light.
Additional embedded fonts: Anton, Barlow Condensed, IBM Plex Mono.

OFFLINE PLAYBACK
Extract the entire folder and open index.html in a recent Chrome or Edge browser.
No internet connection, external library, server or installation is required.
Select slide 03 to play the four-second intro. It plays on each entry.
The album and song card appears in the foreground, then shrinks into the upper-left header with nonlinear easing.
The same card stays in the slide header after the full-screen DAW fades away.
DAW highlights use frosted glass and a glow on both sides of the playhead. Timing stays linear at 180 BPM for two 4/4 bars.
Arrow keys, Space, Escape or SKIP INTRO dismiss the intro to the slide content.
The original Japanese track title is retained as a proper name; presentation controls and copy are English.

3D archive arrangement and continuous wave motion reference: RhineLabUI by LBEILC, https://github.com/LBEILC/RhineLabUI (MIT; see RhineLabUI-LICENSE.txt). Adapted to local CSS 3D CD cases.
